title: Deliver Iron Ore to Prondingville Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Prondingville Steel Mill** (industry id 6, near tile 16,83).

A likely supplier is **Condworth Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 10, near tile 16,101); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
